question: What kind of unqualified person must not receive this teaching?
premises: One person lacks devotion to the kula.
Another lacks devotion to the guru.
inference: Therefore those devoid of devotion to kula and guru are unqualified recipients.
uncertainties: The sentence continues into following verses.
plain_english: Indeed, to one devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru...
